newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon debt up 14.7 pct at mid year - official.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon debt up 14.7 pct at mid year - official.

text.p: Lebanon's June total outstanding debt rose 1.2 percent to $11.998 billion for a 14.7 percent rise in the first six months of the year, according to finance ministry figures issued on Friday.
Net domestic debt rose 1.1 percent in May to 15,442 billion Lebanese pounds for a 15.6 percent gain since the start of 1997.
Foreign debt rose 0.9 percent in May to $1.969 billion for a 6.1-percent increase in the first six months of the year.
